name: agent-builder-main-flow-decision
body: The `agent-builder` change-set flow runs on the main checkout: the navigator recognises a block, tasks the `agent-builder` subagent on main, the subagent scaffolds or updates `.opencode/agents/**` and `opencode.json` and commits there, the navigator rebases the project worktree onto main and re-scans, and the user restarts opencode and reconnects before implementation continues. The three code surfaces resolve as `docs` File nodes: `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, and `AGENTS.md`. `rust.apg.install` embeds `agent-builder.md` into `~/.opencode/agents/` through `include_str!`. The project-flow rule about the main checkout scopes to the binary's guarded mutations (durable `apg node`/`apg edge` and transient plan/review operations); an agent definition is a consumer artifact committed on main.
